## Setup

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display
from IPython.display import HTML
import geopandas as gpd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
```

```{python}
# load passport viewing data
memberships = pd.read_csv(
    "Data_Files/constituents_w_memberships.csv", 
    dtype={"UofU Employment Status": "string"})
passport = pd.read_csv("Data_Files/passport_viewing_data.csv")
```

## Membership Data

```{python}
print(memberships.describe())
```

```{python}
# Select relevant columns
constituent_locations = memberships[
    ["Constituent ID", "Address ZIP"]
].copy()

# Clean ZIP codes
constituent_locations["Address ZIP"] = (
    constituent_locations["Address ZIP"]
    .astype("string")
    .str.strip()
    .str.extract(r"(\d{5})", expand=False)
)

# Remove missing ZIP codes
constituent_locations = constituent_locations.dropna(
    subset=["Address ZIP"]
)

# Count unique constituents by ZIP
zip_counts = (
    constituent_locations
    .groupby("Address ZIP")
    ["Constituent ID"]
    .nunique()
    .reset_index(name="Constituent Count")
    .sort_values("Constituent Count", ascending=False)
)

display(zip_counts.head())
```

```{python}
print(f"Total constituents: {memberships['Constituent ID'].nunique():,}")

print(
    f"Constituents with ZIP codes: "
    f"{constituent_locations['Constituent ID'].nunique():,}"
)

print(f"Unique ZIP codes: {constituent_locations['Address ZIP'].nunique():,}")
```

```{python}
zcta_url = (
    "https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2025/ZCTA520/"
    "tl_2025_us_zcta520.zip"
)

zctas = gpd.read_file(zcta_url)

display(zctas.head())
```

```{python}
constituent_map = zctas.merge(
    zip_counts,
    left_on="ZCTA5CE20",
    right_on="Address ZIP",
    how="inner"
)

display(
    constituent_map[
        ["ZCTA5CE20", "Constituent Count"]
    ].head()
)
```

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 10))

constituent_map.plot(
    column="Constituent Count",
    cmap="Blues",
    linewidth=0.2,
    edgecolor="white",
    legend=True,
    ax=ax
)

ax.set_title(
    "Geographic Distribution of Constituents by ZIP Code",
    fontsize=16,
    fontweight="bold"
)

ax.axis("off")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Passport Viewing Data

```{python}
# Rename passport title columns
passport = passport.rename(columns={
    "Content.Channel": "Series_Title",
    "Title": "Episode_Title",
    }
)
```

```{python}
# Calculate total number of unique passport accounts
total_accounts = passport["UID"].nunique()

show_summary = (
    passport
    .groupby("Series_Title", as_index=False)
    .agg(
        Reach=("UID", "nunique"),
        total_watch_time_seconds=("Time.Watched", "sum"),
        Avg_Show_Completion_Pct=("Percent.Watched", "mean")
    )
)

# Calculate percent of all accounts that watched each show
show_summary["Reach (%)"] = (
    show_summary["Reach"] / total_accounts * 100
)

# Convert total watch time to hours
show_summary["Watch Time (Hrs)"] = (
    round((show_summary["total_watch_time_seconds"] / 3600), 2)
)

# Drop `total_watch_time_seconds`
show_summary = show_summary.drop(columns=['total_watch_time_seconds'])
```

```{python}
# Sort by `Reach` and `Watch Time (Hrs)`
show_summary = (
    show_summary
    .sort_values(
        ["Reach", "Watch Time (Hrs)"],
        ascending=[False, False]
    )
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

# Set column order
new_order = ["Series_Title", "Reach", "Reach (%)", "Watch Time (Hrs)", "Avg_Show_Completion_Pct"]
show_summary = show_summary.reindex(columns=new_order)


display(HTML(show_summary.to_html(index=False)))
```
